document_type: Authored methodology and reconciliation summary; not an original platform export

campaign.offer: Paid introductory session leading to a paid education programme
campaign.attribution: Assign each deduplicated person/offer enquiry to its first eligible paid touch. Retain source and click ID where available; assisted touches stay separate. Unknown sources are not forced into Meta/Search.
campaign.cohort_rule: Acquire within the stated calendar month; count qualifying payment, attendance and enrolment only within 30 days after that enquiry. Freeze after the latest window closes. Outcomes after that window stay separate.
campaign.qualified_definition: Correct offer/age, serviceable location, valid received contact and stated interest confirmed by sales; no duplicate or spam.
campaign.role: Campaign lead: budget, targeting, keyword exclusions, creative brief and landing-page/CRM coordination. Centre team: qualification, payments, refunds, attendance and enrolment.
reported_actions: Exclude job/toy research queries; separate brand and non-brand review.
Add offer/location qualification and route received enquiries to the centre team.
Review qualified and paid outcomes, then revise creative copy within the same channel budgets.
campaign.source_scope: Dates, role, attribution rules, changes and channel-level reconciliation confirmed by candidate. Original Ads/CRM/payment exports are not attached. Client name is not disclosed.
